theory_mapping.mechanism: Set-conditioned square-root POVM with explicit null outcome. Query/key states encoded by separate 3-qubit circuits (6 input angles + 2 layers local Rz/Ry/Rz + fixed CZ ring). Token probabilities |k†Gq|² where G = (Σ_j k_j k_j† + 0.01 I)^(-1/2). Null probability 0.01 q† S^(-1) q. Context = Σ_j prob_j V_j. No softmax or renormalization. Finite-dimensional Born rule has exact classical replay. Five conditions under identical warm-start and factual CE: disabled (original softmax), quantum (full POVM), fidelity (pairwise fidelity + null normalization), diagonal (discard off-diagonal density), key_mismatch (cyclically permute valid keys, values unchanged).
theory_mapping.experimental_contract: Bounded screen only: 630/631/587 Re-TACRED selected records, seeds 13/29/53/71/97. Eight warmup epochs shared, then six intervention epochs per condition. Validation Macro-F1 selection. Test never used for selection. Synthetic canary (12/6/6 records, seed 13, 2 epochs per phase) required before screen. Protocol frozen: no full-data mode. Historical Q-CFRA disabled and three-view loss not controls. Screen reuses development subset; not formal independent evidence.

correctness.circuit_encoding: ThreeQubitMap applies 6 tanh-scaled input angles to Y/Z rotations, then 2 layers of local Rz/Ry/Rz with fixed CZ ring phase. Implementation matches documented 3-qubit encoding. Gradient test passes at degenerate and distinct spectra.
correctness.povm_construction: Gram matrix S = Σ_valid k_j k_j† + 0.01 I. Inverse square root G = S^(-1/2) via spectral decomposition. Effects E_j = G k_j k_j† G. Null effect E_null = 0.01 G G. Completeness Σ_j E_j + E_null = I verified to atol=1e-9. Probability p_j = q† E_j q, null = q† E_null q. Implementation correct. fidelity mode uses pairwise |q† k_j|² + 0.01 normalization, distinct path but correct alternative.
correctness.gradient_propagation: Loewner divided difference for matrix inverse square root backward avoids eigenvector gradient singularities at repeated roots. Gradcheck passes degenerate initialization and batched distinct spectra. Explicit POVM quadratic form gradients match optimized pure-state path (atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-9). Microbatch accumulation matches logical-batch gradient (atol=1e-7, rtol=2e-4). First-order derivatives correct; second derivatives not claimed.
correctness.attention_bypass: Context intervention returns attention @ value directly, bypassing base softmax/dropout. Disabled mode preserves exact base path including dropout (atol=0, rtol=0). Token probabilities + null = 1 (atol=1e-11). Padding positions zero. Null > 0 observed. Implementation correct.
correctness.masking_and_support: Padding mask enforced: invalid positions zero probability, null = 1 at padding queries. Empty spans rejected at construction. Overlapping subject/object rejected. Token permutation and padding extension preserve probabilities up to index reordering. key_mismatch cycles valid keys while preserving per-query total probability. Correct.

fidelity_gaps: Finite-dimensional Born probabilities admit exact classical matrix replay. No quantum resource advantage established. Implementation documents this explicitly.
Nominal 144 parameters (72 per map) do not imply equal effective capacity across modes. fidelity and diagonal use different computational paths. Effective capacity comparison not resolved.
key_mismatch parity check (mean quantum - mismatch ≤ 0.001) gates mechanism attribution but does not replace task utility evidence. Configuration enforces this distinction.

gradient_and_numerics.precision: Circuit encoding and POVM construction use complex128/float64 for spectral operations. Base model token/position embeddings and tanh projection remain float32. Probability and density matrices float64/complex128. Gradient backward via Loewner divided difference in double precision. Input/output transitions match base dtype. Appropriate mixed precision.
gradient_and_numerics.stability: Ridge 0.01 I added to Gram before inverse square root, ensuring positive definite input. Eigenvalue check rejects non-finite or non-positive spectrum. Null effect prevents zero denominator. Masking prevents division by zero at padding. Gradcheck passes degenerate and distinct spectra. Numerically stable.
gradient_and_numerics.gradient_correctness: Loewner divided difference for f(x)=x^(-1/2) correct at repeated eigenvalues (no eigenvalue-gap divisor). Gradcheck passes degenerate initialization (atol=3e-5, rtol=1e-4) and batched distinct spectra (atol=2e-5, rtol=1e-4). Explicit POVM quadratic form backward matches optimized path (atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-9). Microbatch accumulation matches logical batch (atol=1e-7, rtol=2e-4). Plugin parameters receive non-zero finite gradients. Correct first-order derivatives.
gradient_and_numerics.determinism: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, torch.set_num_threads(1), OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1. Seed controls Python random, NumPy, PyTorch CPU/CUDA. Epoch order frozen per seed; first training record always index 0 in epoch 0. Checkpoint includes RNG state. Resumption verified deterministic. Correct.

lifecycle_correctness.checkpoint_atomicity: Two-generation pointer (latest, previous). save: write checkpoint to temp, verify loadable, atomic rename pointer, remove obsolete. load: verify schema/fingerprint/seed/mode, check latest generation hash. recover_previous: only if latest damaged and previous exists, atomic pointer update, record recovery reason. Correct atomic protocol.
lifecycle_correctness.cursor_recovery: Checkpoint contains next_update, next_indexes (epoch_order(count, seed, epoch)[position:position+logical]), selected_through, best_model, best_metric, best_update, model state_dict, optimizer state_dict, RNG state. Resumption verifies fingerprint/seed/mode/base_state_sha256, restores all state, validates cursor == update_indexes(count, logical, next_update, seed). Uncommitted batches replayed. Completed conditions skip after verifying file/trace/hash. Correct.
lifecycle_correctness.trace_production: sample-trace.v2 schema. Per condition: train/valid/test × initial/best/final replay (diagnostic backward, no optimizer step), plus train selected0 update0 training (actual minibatch update, captured before optimizer step). 10 full-value samples per condition. Artifact refs include path/sha256/bytes. Reader projection provides coordinate_inspector with arbitrary access, source_sha256 matches artifact hashes. NumPy arrays saved without pickle, verified finite. Lineage checks: embedding = token + position, context = attention @ value, delta = after - before, attention sum + null = 1, POVM completeness = I, circuit normalization = 1. Correct.
lifecycle_correctness.trace_validation: Independent validator: structural contract (ecpa_contract_validator), hash verification (per-artifact sha256 rehashed on read), coordinate reader equality (read_values random coordinates match full array), semantic lineage (embedding, context, optimizer update, normalization, POVM completeness, circuit states). 50 traces, 1810+ full arrays verified per lifecycle test.
